bounded_evaluation_protocol_spec.stopping_rule_primary: Whichever occurs FIRST: N = 2,000 eligible complete LO_60 exits OR 30 elapsed 24-hour days from freeze (Target: 2026-10-28 07:31:46 UTC).
bounded_evaluation_protocol_spec.early_stopping_policy: No extension allowed if 30 days elapse before N=2,000; evaluation closes at achieved sample size.

stage_definitions.stage_1_discovery: Historical chronological 50% (N=506 complete exits: 318 steady-state + 188 startup).
stage_definitions.stage_2_temporal_validation: Historical chronological 50% holdout (N=506 complete exits: 100% pure steady-state).
stage_definitions.stage_3_independent_prospective_replicat: Newly accumulated data collected during 30-day bounded evaluation window.

bounded_evaluation_protocol_spec.qualification_dual_gate_rule: Candidate feature must satisfy AUC >= 0.65 AND lower 95% CI > 0.50 in BOTH Stage 2 AND Stage 3.

three_way_outcome_taxonomy.QUALIFIED: AUC >= 0.65 and lower 95% CI > 0.50 across Stage 2 & Stage 3.
three_way_outcome_taxonomy.CONFIRMED_NULL_RESULT: Upper 95% CI bound on Stage 3 is < 0.65, ruling out target effect size with high precision.
three_way_outcome_taxonomy.INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED: Qualification target missed (AUC < 0.65), but upper 95% CI includes 0.65.

bounded_evaluation_protocol_spec.repeated_peeking_protection: Interim automated scripts monitor feed health and cohort counts only. Formal AUC & CI inference evaluated ONCE at stopping boundary.

feature_semantics_documentation.F1_retained_mfe_ratio: Contemporaneous unrealized PnL at T_condition divided by MFE PnL at T_condition. MFE <= 0 -> 0.0. Zero retrospective lookahead.
feature_semantics_documentation.F2_exit_momentum_score: Average 15m and 30m Coralys trajectory score at T_condition.
feature_semantics_documentation.target_outcome_binary: 1 if LO_60 > 0 (Opportunity Cost / Favorable Continuation), 0 if LO_60 <= 0 (Protected Exit).

predefined_qualification_checklist.requirement: All features available strictly at T_condition without future lookahead
predefined_qualification_checklist.supporting_evidence: Zero lookahead verified: T_feature <= T_condition for all 1,551 reconstructed records.

predefined_qualification_checklist.requirement: Complete eligible ENGINE_EXIT population reconciled and documented
predefined_qualification_checklist.supporting_evidence: 1,551 total exits (1,363 steady-state + 188 startup); 1,012 complete LO_60 (824 steady-state + 188 startup).

predefined_qualification_checklist.requirement: Fixed LO15/LO30/LO60 horizon definitions with incomplete windows excluded
predefined_qualification_checklist.supporting_evidence: LO_60 = PnL(T_exit+60m) - PnL(T_exit). 539 incomplete windows marked AWAITING_HORIZON_DATA.

predefined_qualification_checklist.requirement: Stage 2 Hypo AUC >= 0.65 AND lower 95% CI > 0.50 (100% pure steady-state, N=506)
predefined_qualification_checklist.supporting_evidence: Stage 2 point AUC 0.5452 remains below the 0.65 qualification threshold.

predefined_qualification_checklist.requirement: Stage 3 Hypo AUC >= 0.65 AND lower 95% CI > 0.50 (Untouched prospective cohort)
predefined_qualification_checklist.supporting_evidence: Accumulating prospective observations until 30-day boundary (2026-10-28 07:31:46 UTC) or N=2,000.

directional_pattern_counts.fdr_procedure_specification: Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure applied to Mann-Whitney U two-tailed p-values at alpha=0.05 across m=105 estimable symbols.

q3_discrimination_audit.executive_summary: RP-607 Q3 Discrimination Audit Canonical Report (V3 Spec) reconciled all AUC score directions, subgroup metrics, source snapshot metadata (snapshot ts: 2026-09-28 07:31:46 UTC), and symbol-level evidence layer. Retained MFE Ratio (F1) achieved Stage 1 Discovery Raw AUC = 0.5145, Hypothesis Score AUC = 0.4855 (95% CI: [0.4486, 0.5189]) and Stage 2 Temporal Validation Raw AUC = 0.4548, Hypothesis Score AUC = 0.5452 (95% CI: [0.5046, 0.5903]). Symbol-level diagnostic analysis across 114 tickers (105 estimable) yielded median within-symbol AUC of 0.5000 (IQR: 0.3334). Because collective empirical AUCs remain below the 0.65 qualification target, RP-607 Q3 is formally confirmed as 'PENDING / INCONCLUSIVE'. RP-605 baseline remains frozen and RP-608 shadow policy continues isolated.
